prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate a complete portrait background for chapter 1, Four beginnings, of Elements - Icons. Reference image 1 is a PRINT STYLE AND PALETTE reference only; do not copy its blank central composition. The user wants a richly illustrated place people can explore and move objects around.
STYLE: Rustic, earnest old-fashioned COLOURED WOODCUT. Match the supplied references' warm black, dull ochre, clay/rust red, slate blue, muted olive and creamy carved cuts, but visibly simpler and less polished than the first reference: a small number of broad confident cuts, occasional knife slips, uneven angular contours, slightly crooked handmade things, thin missed patches in ink and colour plates shifted slightly beyond or short of their black outlines. Imperfect registration must look printed, not blurred. No smooth gradients, modeled digital shading, tiny decorative hatching, glossy highlights, outline stickers, cute toy proportions, circular badges, frames or presentation shadows. Humble functional objects, easily recognised at 56 pixels. Natural, clear silhouettes before texture. Opaque warm cream paper across the whole background.
COMPOSITION: tall 780:1688 aspect ratio. One coherent rural riverside landscape viewed from the near/south bank looking across the water, slightly elevated. The river enters from the RIGHT edge around 44% down the image and flows toward the LEFT edge around 76% down, with long directional pale ripples and a visible gentle fall to the left. This right-to-left flow is a continuity anchor for the whole story. Foreground uneven ochre earth and grass, river stones, a few broad carved leaves and modest natural patches of bare soil for work, fully illustrated rather than a blank interface mat. A distinctive FORKED WILLOW on the LEFT bank at 22% width, 50% height. Two slim poplar trees stand together on the far bank near the middle. Low twin hills are on the far RIGHT horizon. A small apple orchard occupies the UPPER RIGHT near-bank hillside. Near its outer edge, very small in the distance, there is only a rudimentary lean-to of three crooked poles and a few thatching bundles; no finished house, no glass, no chimney. No bridge, dock, waterwheel, mill or lighthouse yet. A narrow footpath follows the near bank downhill to the left. Morning light comes from the right. Plain nature, a lived-in rural world; no cute fantasy props, no heroic mountains, no lettering, interface, circles, pictograms or enclosing border. Keep genuine irregular carved linework, imperfect colour registration and flat printing throughout, not a digital painting with a woodcut texture.
